name: Night
overview: Scripture reveals that night is a divinely created part of the natural order, distinct from day by God's design, as seen in Genesis 1 where God separates light from darkness and appoints the lesser light and stars to govern the night. Night begins at evening and continues until morning, serving as a time marked by God's sovereign control and purpose. The creation of night alongside day reflects God's intentional establishment of rhythms in creation, highlighting His authority over both light and darkness.
